From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintechcorp.com>, Samantha Kim <samantha.kim@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: FinTechCorp — follow-up: security/compliance + incident response evidence

Hi Liam & Samantha,

Great to meet with you both earlier — appreciate the time and the detailed run through of FinTechCorp's latency and throughput requirements. As promised, summarizing the security/compliance items we discussed and next steps so your legal/security teams have a single thread to reference.

Key items we covered:
- SOC 2: FinTechCorp asked for our SOC 2 status and whether Redwood can provide a redacted Type II report.
- GDPR / HIPAA: you wanted confirmation about processing locations, SCCs, and whether we support BAA/HIPAA controls.
- Vendor questionnaire: you mentioned sending over an initial vendor security questionnaire (VSA / RFP).
- Incident response & breach notification: you asked about our notification timelines, escalation path, and evidence for BCP/DR.

Next steps / asks from FinTechCorp:
1) If you can share the vendor security questionnaire, we will start populating it and loop in our security team.
2) Clarify the timeframe you require for breach notification — regulatory vs internal SLAs (e.g., 72 hours vs 30 days).
3) List of specific artifacts you need for BCP/DR (table-top exercise reports, RTO/RPO figures, DR test logs).

My action items:
- Attach the vendor questionnaire template (if you don’t mind sending yours, we can merge).
- Pull a redacted SOC 2 Type II (2025) and a short BCP/DR overview from security.

Marissa & Monica — tagging you both to confirm: can we provide a redacted SOC 2 PDF and the BCP/DR overview by EOD Tuesday? Also, please confirm standard breach notification timelines we can offer for enterprise contracts.

Thanks — happy to set a follow-up if that’s easier than threading.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

I'm attaching the initial vendor security questionnaire (VSA) — it's our standard 3rd-party security intake. For context, our security team typically expects the completed questionnaire and supporting artifacts within 10 business days of receiving it.

Subject: Re: FinTechCorp — follow-up: security/compliance + incident response evidence

Appreciate that, Samantha — received the VSA. We will begin populating immediately.

A few clarifying items from our side so we can prioritize artifacts:
- Incident notification: Monica, can you confirm Redwood's standard contractual breach notification commitment (we typically commit to notifying customers within 72 hours of confirming a security incident affecting customer data; need confirmation for external messaging).
- HIPAA / BAA: Liam — do you need a formal BAA or just evidence of HIPAA-aligned controls? Seems from the call you may have both regulated and non-regulated product lines.
- BCP/DR artifacts: please prioritize what you need out of the following: DR runbook, recent tabletop test summary (last 12 months), RTO/RPO numbers, and evidence of off-site backups.

If OK, we'll return the completed VSA plus a redacted SOC 2 Type II and a BCP/DR overview by EOD Tuesday (our security team will attach the redacted PDFs).

Thanks — Ben

Subject: RE: FinTechCorp — follow-up: security/compliance + incident response evidence

Ben / team,

We're on it. Summary of what security will provide and suggested language for contracting:

1) SOC 2 Type II (2025) — we can provide a redacted PDF (control sections and auditor opinion visible; customer-specific configs redacted). See attached.
2) Incident response & breach notification — standard contract language we use: "Redwood will notify Customer of a confirmed security incident affecting Customer Data within 72 hours of confirmation and will provide an initial incident report within 5 business days." We can accept reasonable carve-outs requested by legal but 72-hour initial notification is standard for enterprise.
3) BCP/DR evidence — we'll attach a 2-page BCP/DR overview (high level RTO: 4 hours for critical inference endpoints, RPO: 1 hour for KV/cache persistence; tabletop summary available on request). Full runbooks are internal and require an NDA; we can provide redacted excerpts.

Attachments included: SOC2-Type2-Report-Redacted-2025.pdf (redacted), BCP_DR_Overview.pdf

Marissa: please add a short note about our ability to sign a BAA where technically required (we have a defined BAA flow; will need the scope of PHI processing).

Monica Patel
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

[Attachments: SOC2-Type2-Report-Redacted-2025.pdf (stub); BCP_DR_Overview.pdf (stub)]

Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinTechCorp — follow-up: security/compliance + incident response evidence

Monica / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of clarifications from our security and legal teams before we proceed: 

1) The 72-hour notification commitment is acceptable as an initial notification window, but legal is asking for the exact definition of "confirmation" (i.e., time of detection vs time of verification). Can you provide the formal definition Redwood uses in contracts?

2) For the BCP/DR artifacts, we'd like the tabletop summary (redacted) and the RTO/RPO figures in a single page we can circulate internally. Can you confirm you can provide that by EOD Friday?

3) On HIPAA/BAA — can you confirm whether Redwood has previously signed BAAs and whether there are standard exclusions (e.g., subprocessor lists or third-party telemetry vendors)? If you can point us to an example BAA or process note, that would be helpful.

If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-minute follow-up with your security leads this week to iron out contract language.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Security | FinTechCorp
liam.oconnor@fintechcorp.com
